cases.title: SIM Cards Not Connecting — Matcha Electric (USC DS3 Circuit Issue)
cases.findings: USC DS3 circuit drops causing Delete Session Requests on Plantsville, CT SIMs. Disconnection rate 92%+ on worst SIM. Brooklyn SIM shows normal ~5.37% SGSN timeout behavior (different failure mode). USC escalation CW-3824 — rep Dylan Dreiling noted they can't get responses from their own roaming support. JIRA escalated.
cases.notes: Sensei-assisted analysis. Investigated Brooklyn ICCID ...1410 — confirmed different failure pattern than Plantsville. Brooklyn = normal SGSN timeouts; Plantsville = roaming partner core transport failures. Same carrier (MCC 310/MNC 410), same IMSI5 profile, but fundamentally different root causes.
cases.response: Awaiting USC repair on DS3 circuit. JIRA CW-3824.
